title: VTT Ecosystem, Licensing & Capability Matrix

implementation_scope.purpose: Define a deterministic read-only, evidence-backed VTT ecosystem, licensing and capability matrix that records what target platforms explicitly support, do not support, conditionally support or leave unknown, with source provenance, without selecting a vendor or implementing an adapter.
authorized: evidence-backed platform identity, hosting, licensing and distribution classification with source provenance

explicit capability states supported, unsupported, conditional or unknown across rules packages, modules/plugins, sheets, compendiums, maps/scenes, automation, APIs/live communication and import/export
evidence references with stable source identity, publisher, title, locator, observed/accessed date and provenance sufficient to distinguish sourced facts from unresolved gaps

capability-driven integration ceiling classification using VTI Level 1 export/content pack, Level 2 synchronized companion and Level 3 native system/rules package semantics without turning the classification into vendor selection
explicit platform constraints for authentication, credentials, marketplace/publication path, self-hosting/local/server availability and distribution where public evidence supports them
missing, stale, contradictory or unavailable evidence remains unresolved or unknown rather than being inferred as support
deterministic capability-matrix ordering and deterministic receipts independent of supplied platform or evidence ordering
not_authorized: vendor selection, ranking, winner recommendation or VTI-09 platform commitment
credential use, external account mutation, provider activation or external synchronization mutation
adapter implementation, canonical game-state mutation, package publication, tester distribution, release or deployment
hidden-information, visibility, ownership, consent or GM-authority bypass
manufacturing unsupported platform fidelity or treating unknown capability as supported
durable VTI persistence, a new migration or an external synchronization ledger
